tokens.name: green-950
tokens.usage: Palette · Deep Emerald, the darkest step of the brand green. Sidebar ground and dark social backgrounds. White text on it is 12.3:1; Young Green 7.6:1.

tokens.name: green-800
tokens.usage: Palette · hover and pressed shade of the brand green, and the green for text on `green-100` (white on it 6.8:1).

tokens.name: green-700
tokens.usage: Palette · Emerald Fall, the brand colour from the brand manual (HEX #108652, RGB 16 134 82). Primary buttons, links, the current nav item, the logo. White text on it is 4.6:1.

tokens.name: green-100
tokens.usage: Palette · the lightest green: selected rows, the Available badge, soft highlights. Put `green-800` text on it, not `green-700` (4.0:1).

tokens.name: green-50
tokens.usage: Palette · a whisper of green for row hover and the quotation file's zebra rows.

tokens.name: gray-900
tokens.usage: Palette · near-black with a green cast. All text.

tokens.name: gray-600
tokens.usage: Palette · secondary text and icons.

tokens.name: gray-400
tokens.usage: Palette · borders of form controls (3.3:1 on white).

tokens.name: gray-200
tokens.usage: Palette · hairlines and card borders.

tokens.name: gray-100
tokens.usage: Palette · table headers, totals, read-only fields.

tokens.name: young-green
tokens.usage: Brand secondary · Young Green (HEX #97DF67). Accent only on dark grounds: highlighted words, rules and small marks on `black` (13.1:1) or `green-950` (7.6:1). Never text on white (1.6:1) or on `green-700` (2.9:1).

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Brand primary · Pure Black (HEX #000000). The brand manual's dark ground for the white logo and display type.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The main content area — plain white. Cards sit on it with a `line` border.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, form panels, the machine card.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs and drawers — always with `shadow-md` or `shadow-lg`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header row, totals block, read-only fields, search field, spec cells.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of table rows, list items and quiet buttons.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected row, selected filter, machine already in the quote. `ink` (13:1) and `ink-muted` (5.1:1 light, 5.9:1 dark) read on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`, `surface-selected` (≥13:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, units (hp, kg, L), hints, placeholders and icons on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-sunken`, `surface-selected` (≥5.1:1 light, ≥5.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only — never the sole border of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, checkboxes and secondary buttons — ≥3.3:1 on `bg` and `surface` in both themes.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one action colour: primary buttons, links, checked boxes, the current step, focus. As text on `bg`/`surface` 4.6:1 light, 7.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of `primary` controls.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` / `primary-hover` (4.6:1 light, 7.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet green fill behind `green-800` text: the Available badge, a done step, the tab count.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Available / Accepted text and icon on `success-soft` (green-800 keeps it above 4.5:1).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of success badges and banners.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Functional only: Reserved / Expiring text and icon on `warning-soft` (5.3:1 light). Kept muted and small — never decorative.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of warning badges and banners.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Functional only: errors, Rejected / Discontinued, destructive buttons; text on `danger-soft` and `surface` (≥5.6:1 light, ≥7.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of error banners and danger badges.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral status (Draft, Sent, On order) text on `info-soft` (5.2:1 light, 7.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of neutral badges.

tokens.name: nav-bg
tokens.usage: Sidebar and mobile drawer ground — the brand green at its darkest.

tokens.name: nav-ink
tokens.usage: Nav labels and icons on `nav-bg` (10.7:1 light, 13.7:1 dark) and on `nav-hover`.

tokens.name: nav-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Nav section labels and the user's role line on `nav-bg` (7.6:1).

tokens.name: nav-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a nav item on `nav-bg`.

tokens.name: nav-active
tokens.usage: Fill of the current nav item — the primary green on the dark sidebar; its text is `nav-ink-active`.

tokens.name: nav-ink-active
tokens.usage: Text and icon of the current nav item on `nav-active` (5.7:1).

tokens.name: nav-line
tokens.usage: Divider above the user block in the sidebar. Decorative.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Quotation file ground. The printed/PDF quotation is always light, whatever the app theme, so it uses only theme-invariant tokens: `paper` and the palette.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element (≥5.7:1 on `bg`). Inside the sidebar use `nav-ink`.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and the mobile nav drawer.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Main data series (e.g. accepted quotes).

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second series (e.g. sent quotes) — a lighter step of the same green. Label series directly; don't rely on the shade alone.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third series or a target band.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Baseline, previous period, “other”.

fonts.note: Primary brand font (titles, highlights, calls). Commercial licence, not bundled: install it locally; until then the stack falls back to Helvetica Neue / Helvetica / Arial.

families.display: "Helvetica Now Display", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The quotation file title, login and empty-state headlines. One per screen.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title on mobile; detail-page heading (machine model, quote number).

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card titles, dialog titles, machine names in the catalog.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Delivery in 30 days from the signed order.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis, client names, the first column of tables.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Metadata, helper text under fields, dense tables.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Footnotes, chart axis labels, legal lines on the quotation file.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, table headers, spec names, nav section titles — sentence case, never uppercase.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button and tab text (13px in the small size).

styles.name: kpi
styles.usage: The big number in a stat card. Tabular figures.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Machine price on cards, the quote's grand total. Tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside badges; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons; gap between badge and text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell vertical padding; input horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; page gutter below 768px; grid gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter ≥768px; gap between card groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections; page gutter ≥1280px.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Quotation file margins; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, small chips, image corners inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, nav items, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, dialogs, the machine card.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, counts, avatars, the stepper dots — soft pills.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards (with a `line` border). Barely there — the white page carries the layout.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Hovered machine card, menus, popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the mobile nav drawer.

size.note: Fixed dimensions of controls and the app frame.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and inputs in dense tables and toolbars (desktop only).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs, selects and nav items.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary actions on mobile and the quote builder footer; meets the 44px touch target.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar, ≥1024px.

tokens.name: sidebar-rail
tokens.usage: Icon-only sidebar rail, 768–1023px.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Top bar with search, user and (on mobile) the menu button.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the page content area.

breakpoint.note: Mobile-first min-width breakpoints. CSS custom properties can't drive media queries — copy these numbers into @media rules.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Catalog grid goes to 2 columns; tables still stack as cards.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Sidebar appears as an icon rail; tables render as tables; gutter `space-6`.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Full sidebar; catalog 3 columns; quote builder shows the summary as a sticky right column.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Catalog 4 columns; gutter `space-8`.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table header, sticky quote summary.

tokens.name: z-topbar
tokens.usage: Top bar.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: Mobile nav drawer and its scrim.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts and snackbars.
